answer: Admission auction stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch offers 200 slots: bidders compete, winners pay the 40-coin clearing price into a vault locked 20 epochs, and each winner's referral vine is published so star clusters are flagged. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 winning bids, 40,000 coins locked, against a 20-coin 30-day reward per slot - a canyon no forger crosses profitably. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
